# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.11

Version 1.4.11 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.10

A cleanup of the port's own code where it had become tangled, with nothing to see in the game:

- **Controls** (keyboard, mouse, gamepad): the code that turns them into the GameCube controller's state is split
  into steps (keyboard, keys typed into a text box, gamepad and plugging it in, sticks, the chat button).
- **Drawing**: the code that sends each draw's state to OpenGL is split into one part per kind of state.
- **Textures**: the four ways a texture is found (a captured screen, the cache, a texture pack, decoding it) share
  their steps instead of each having a copy.
- **Settings**: settings.ini is read from tables.
- One fix on the way: with subtractive blending, only the first draw after the mode was set subtracted, and the
  ones after it added instead. The game's own code does not use this mode, so nothing on screen changes.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.11 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.11-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.11-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.11-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.11-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

Every changed function was run side by side with the code of v1.4.10, on the same random input, with fake SDL and
OpenGL layers that log every call:

- the settings file: 100,000 random settings.ini files give the same settings;
- the controls: 300,000 frames of keyboard, mouse and gamepad input (plugged in and pulled out, typing and chat
  states over frame sequences) give the same pad state and the same calls;
- drawing: 60,000 draws make the same OpenGL calls (except the subtract fix above);
- textures: 200,000 texture loads, palettes and texture-pack replacements make the same OpenGL calls.

Each of these tests was checked to catch bugs planted on purpose. An independent review with its own tests, and
builds with gcc 32/64, clang, MinGW and the Android NDK, found no other difference. The game itself, v1.4.10 against
v1.4.11 through the same 43 scripted scenarios: 921 screenshots, the logs and the saves identical. Real key presses
(walking, F3, Ctrl+S, a key held while the message board opens, typing) behave the same. All unit tests pass.
Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.11, versionCode 10411).

## Known limitations

- On the first day, nothing can be saved before you have met a villager: the game itself does not allow it.
- No test on a real arm64 device was possible here; arm64 runs the same 64-bit code that was checked on x86_64.
- In Korean mode, passwords cannot be entered: their characters are kana and symbols that the Korean patch's
  input has no keys for, and its font shows some pairs of them as one Hangul syllable. This is how the patch is
  made, also on the GameCube.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
